title: Alexandria claim agreement score
description: Normative stance-and-strength score for a research model that returned output and was graded. A failed research call has no score and must be represented separately; it must never be coerced to 0.

oneOf.description: Strong contradiction: stated directly and unhedged.
Weak contradiction: implied or in passing.
Graded-silent: the model responded, but the blind grading pass found no bearing statement.
Weak support: implied or in passing.
Strong support: stated directly and unhedged.
